import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    bitCoins = int(data[1])
    values = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    
    costs = []
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if values[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if odd == even:
            diff = abs(values[i + 1] - values[i])
            heapq.heappush(costs, diff)
    
    count = 0
    while costs and costs[0] <= bitCoins:
        bitCoins -= heapq.heappop(costs)
        count += 1
    
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
